change_from_previous.note: Not a regression in verdict — a change in what the run is allowed to claim. The team override committed in c7b717d makes a whole-repository trace a planning audit with allow_gate=false; the 2026-09-06 run predates that policy and issued a gate it would no longer be permitted to issue. The inventory also grew: 30 Epic 4 requirements (ACM11-FPO, S4.1a-DP, S4.1c-SAG, S4.2a-OP, S4.2b-TR, S4.2d-DS) entered the oracle, so 258 became 288 and the previous 88% was measured against an inventory that no longer describes the product.
